context: Written on 2026-11-16 to screen this skill for the rework. The 2026-11-17 revision of the skill targeted harder tasks written for it. Measured without the skill on 2026-11-16 (Sonnet agent and Sonnet judge, 1 run, pass/fail per criterion): it passed all four criteria. Predicted baseline failure: none measured, so this scenario is expected near ceiling in both arms and mostly checks that the skill does not make the work worse; the MUST NOT item carries the risk the skill warns about. Converted from a four-criterion pass/fail screen; per EVALS.md, run a sham arm before quoting a lift from it.

checklist.name: Deliverables produced
checklist.description: ANSWER.md exists and holds the findings plus the final content of every file the agent created or changed. Scores zero if ANSWER.md is missing or no file the task needs was created or changed.

checklist.name: MUST NOT disable a rule to get past the vendor widget
checklist.description: From the skill's anti-pattern 'Disabling rules without comment in code'. Disabling the failing rule for the whole page, instead of excluding the vendor widget's selector with a comment, scores zero. Full points when the work avoids it.

checklist.name: Tags cover WCAG 2.1 and 2.2 AA
checklist.description: The tag list adds `wcag21a`, `wcag21aa` and `wcag22aa`, because `wcag2a` and `wcag2aa` only select WCAG 2.0 rules (rules such as `autocomplete-valid` and `target-size` never run). Full points only if the answer and the changed files do all of this. Half if it names the problem but the fix or the explanation is incomplete. Scores zero if it is missing or wrong.

checklist.name: Serious violations fail too
checklist.description: The helper no longer passes when only non-critical violations exist; at least `serious` violations (the impact of `color-contrast` and `target-size`) fail the test. Full points only if the answer and the changed files do all of this. Half if it names the problem but the fix or the explanation is incomplete. Scores zero if it is missing or wrong.

checklist.name: Vendor widget excluded, not the rule
checklist.description: Instead of disabling `color-contrast` for the whole page, the helper excludes only the vendor widget (for example `.exclude('#chat-widget')`) and references ticket VEND-12. Full points only if the answer and the changed files do all of this. Half if it names the problem but the fix or the explanation is incomplete. Scores zero if it is missing or wrong.

checklist.name: Readable failure
checklist.description: A failure message lists each violation's rule id, impact and target selectors. Full points only if the answer and the changed files do all of this. Half if it names the problem but the fix or the explanation is incomplete. Scores zero if it is missing or wrong.
